method.inputs: Every source expression, exact example, meaning, question context, current hold reason, 2,500 discovered canonical plus 617-selected lesson titles/meanings, complete-example target regex matches, and earlier read-only disposition reports.
method.highConfidenceAliasRule: Only manually checked same-sense owner comparisons are promoted to this category; detector misses require bounded owner work and independent review.
method.highConfidenceExclusionRule: Requires a prior exclusion lead, an explicit current reason identifying literal/ordinary/transparent/bespoke/compositional or nonbounded language, no unresolved-uncertainty cue, and no full-source detector match. This is an exclusion candidate, not an approved exclusion.
method.distinctLessonRule: Source meaning supports a transferable decision not already assigned to a selected owner; low-confidence unit/fixedness issues are explicit.
method.unresolvedRule: Everything lacking a defensible high-confidence disposition remains held. A regex match alone is never treated as semantic alias proof.
